quests.title: The Welkynd Census

find.text: A scholar's census slate leans against the gate-arch: eight stone-names in a column, five struck through in a fresh hand. The last line reads, in Aldmeri: 'Then the Tower.'

quests.desc: A census slate at an Alessian gate lists eight light-stones, five of them struck through in a fresh hand.
quests.pitch: A scholar at an old gate says someone is taking a census of the Ayleid lamps, and crossing them off.

objectives.text: Find the first relit lamp in the Shardiuss pit and follow the cabal's route west.
Relight the Miscarcand name-lamp and carry its flame to the Valenwood towers.
Relight the Ne Salas pillar and take the cabal's tally on to the star-vault.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The lamps are being relit across the Cyrodiil ruins, the Valenwood vaults and the Tower of the Summerset Isles.

quests.title: The Welkynd Census (II)
quests.desc: The lamps are being relit across the Cyrodiil ruins, the Valenwood vaults and the Tower of the Summerset Isles.
quests.pitch: A scholar at an old gate says someone is taking a census of the Ayleid lamps, and crossing them off.

objectives.text: Relight the star-vault's ceiling and follow the white flame to the burned city.
Relight the burned city's cistern lamp and sail for the Crystal Tower.
Climb the Crystal Tower to the lens-room where the last stone waits.
Face the Lampwright Magister in the vaults beneath the Tower.

quests.outro: I lit the eighth stone with my own hand. The Tower's lens turned slowly and, for the span of a breath, the sky above Summerset showed every star a thousand years gone. The Lampwrights bowed. I did not know what I had begun.

quests.title: The Ash Remembers

find.text: A glass urn at a ghostfence gate-post holds a pinch of grey ash and a card: 'Falls where it chooses. Remembers what it burned. Follow the fall.' A map of the prevailing winds is pinned beneath.

quests.desc: A glass urn at the ghostfence holds a pinch of ash and a card: 'Falls where it chooses. Remembers what it burned.'
quests.pitch: A Telvanni scholar insists that ash is a kind of speech, and that it has begun to say something.

objectives.text: Gather a pinch of ash at the crater lip and follow the fall east.
Visit the Dunmer refugees of Cheydinhal and learn what their ash-jars hold.
Hear the ash-yam farmers of Raven Rock describe what the fallen ash says.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The wind's trail runs from the volcano through a refugee canal and an island grove to the roots of the Hist.

quests.title: The Ash Remembers (II)
quests.desc: The wind's trail runs from the volcano through a refugee canal and an island grove to the roots of the Hist.
quests.pitch: A Telvanni scholar insists that ash is a kind of speech, and that it has begun to say something.

objectives.text: Walk the grove at dusk and listen to the ash in the roots.
Cross the border at Helstrom and follow the ash into the fen.
Ask the Hist-sages of Thorn to read the ash in the Great Pool.
Lay the gathered ashes at the roots of the abandoned village and listen.

quests.outro: The great Hist-root took the ashes into itself and, for an hour, I heard every name they had been. The ash will fall again, but it will fall quieter now. It has been heard.

quests.title: The Dwemer Dial

find.text: A lever behind a stilled conveyor drops a bronze plate. Its face is a dial with one hand, its figure scratched with a tiny cross and, in scholar's script: 'Eight of these. All the same figure. All ticking.'

quests.desc: A bronze dial behind a stilled conveyor, one hand, one cross, and the note: 'Eight of these, all ticking.'
quests.pitch: A scholar in the fabrication hall says there are eight dials, and that they have never been wrong.

objectives.text: Find Arkngthand's dial above the centrifuge and compare its figure.
Take the dial from Nchardak's coolant hall before the ice takes it.
Read the Kagrumez dial under the star-dome and match its tick.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The dials are scattered across Morrowind, Solstheim, High Rock, Hammerfell and Elsweyr, and all answer to a spire on a rock.

quests.title: The Dwemer Dial (II)
quests.desc: The dials are scattered across Morrowind, Solstheim, High Rock, Hammerfell and Elsweyr, and all answer to a spire on a rock.
quests.pitch: A scholar in the fabrication hall says there are eight dials, and that they have never been wrong.

objectives.text: Unfasten the Mthartzel dial from the pump hall's gauge-wall.
Dig the Volenfell dial out of its sand-drift.
Find the dial beneath the colossus's chest and note how far it has turned.
Reach the spire's summit and hold the last dial before it reaches its mark.

quests.outro: At the spire's summit I held the last dial's hand an inch from its mark. The brass at my feet hummed, the brass in a hundred ruins hummed. I did not let it fall. I do not know what would have come, but I knew it would have been very old.

quests.title: The Sugar Road

find.text: A sugar-urn at the meadow's edge holds a debt-slip folded around a coin. The slip bears a watermark: a crescent moon and a ledger. 'Purchased. Do not pay the farmer. Pay the Counting-House.'

quests.desc: A debt-slip in a sugar-urn with a crescent-and-ledger watermark: 'Do not pay the farmer. Pay the Counting-House.'
quests.pitch: A farmer says her debts were bought by a house she has never met, and that its slips bear a moon.

objectives.text: Trace the farm's purchased debt to the sugar-port's counting-room.
Open the Counting-House's branch behind a Senchal sugar warehouse.
Take the caravan-mother's debt-slips to the next town on the trade-road.
Follow the debt-slips from Rawlkha's lantern market north into Cyrodiil.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The slips' trail runs from sugar farms and Khajiit caravans through river and lake towns to a stilt-market in the Bitter Coast.

quests.title: The Sugar Road (II)
quests.desc: The slips' trail runs from sugar farms and Khajiit caravans through river and lake towns to a stilt-market in the Bitter Coast.
quests.pitch: A farmer says her debts were bought by a house she has never met, and that its slips bear a moon.

objectives.text: Trace the Crescent Ledger's river-agents in Bravil's flooded cellars.
Take the ledger's night-boats from the Lunar Fang Docks toward Morrowind.
Break the Counting-House's silt-strider ledger-room in Balmora.
Open the strongbox beneath the Gnaar Mok stilts and face the Pale Lender.

quests.outro: The strongbox rose out of the mud on its chain, heavy with years instead of gold. I opened it, and I read the names, and I burned the slips one by one. I do not know how many were freed. I know I burned them all.

quests.title: The Bone Census

find.text: A great dragon's rib-arch with a gap in its spine: one vertebra, neatly removed, a clean saw-cut. A tag in a courtly hand: 'Number 14 of 41. Inspected. Collected.'

quests.desc: A dragon's rib-arch with one vertebra neatly removed and a courtly tag: 'Number 14 of 41. Collected.'
quests.pitch: A bone-picker says every dragon grave he knows is missing a single piece, taken cleanly and tagged.

objectives.text: Search the Akaviri barrow for the next tagged bone-niche.
Climb Hvitkald to the peak's cairn and read the tag left on a frozen rib.
Find the bone-arch's missing vertebra among the singing stones.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The missing bones trace from desert and mountain graves to an ice mound and a valley of ribs, and on to a serpent temple.

quests.title: The Bone Census (II)
quests.desc: The missing bones trace from desert and mountain graves to an ice mound and a valley of ribs, and on to a serpent temple.
quests.pitch: A bone-picker says every dragon grave he knows is missing a single piece, taken cleanly and tagged.

objectives.text: Climb the frozen mound and find the bone the serpent-court could not take.
Cross the valley of ribs and find the bone-marked cradle path to the temple.
Reach the temple's spine-cradle and decide where the forty-first bone goes.

quests.outro: In the serpent temple a spine of forty-one vertebrae lay in a cradle, two short of its full length. I took the one I had carried and laid it down, but not in its place. The court's ladder will remain forty-one rungs; it will not reach.

quests.title: The Tide-Ledger

find.text: A scale-mosaic tile at the temple's threshold bears an unfamiliar tide-glyph and a navigator's mark. Scratched into its edge: 'One of nine. Seek the other eight. Read at low tide only.'

quests.desc: A scale-mosaic tile bears a navigator's tide-glyph: 'One of nine. Read at low tide only.'
quests.pitch: A serpent-priest says the tile came from a ledger torn in nine, each piece hidden in a different sea.

objectives.text: Find the harbour's hidden ledger-page behind its sealed manifest.
Read the lighthouse's treaty plate for a tide-glyph and carry it north.
Pry open the wreck's bow-chest for a ledger page among the barnacles.
Search Firsthold's lighthouse for the fourth page, hidden in its lens-case.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The ledger's nine pieces lie in ports from Hammerfell and Solstheim to the Maormer isles and Yokuda.

quests.title: The Tide-Ledger (II)
quests.desc: The ledger's nine pieces lie in ports from Hammerfell and Solstheim to the Maormer isles and Yokuda.
quests.pitch: A serpent-priest says the tile came from a ledger torn in nine, each piece hidden in a different sea.

objectives.text: Take the fifth page from the keeper's totem and look for the Maormer's copy.
Consult the sea-king's window for the sixth page and the Maormer's secret.
Bring the gathered pages to the Ra Gada drill-master and ask his counsel.
Lay the nine pages on the funeral barge and read the ledger's tide.

quests.outro: In the sunken temple's hall I laid the ninth page against the other eight and a chart of tides unfolded across the water. The road home was shorter than I had feared, and stranger. I set the pages back, one in each of nine ports, so no one people would own the road.

quests.title: The Sundered Crown

find.text: A king's tomb has a seal cut cleanly in two, the other half missing. Beside it is a fresh chisel-mark and a note: 'Number three. The ring is gone. The ring of the Hollow King.'

quests.desc: A royal tomb's seal cut in two, with a note: 'Number three. The ring is gone. The ring of the Hollow King.'
quests.pitch: A grave-warden says someone has been taking pieces of royal regalia from tombs, one realm at a time.

objectives.text: Look for the missing throne-arm inscription in the desert king's hall.
Search the hollow tree's heartwood for the missing tomb-panel.
Ask the island keepers of Soulrest which crypt was opened last.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The pieces of the Hollow King lie in barrows, throne-halls, ships and ice from High Rock to Akavir.

quests.title: The Sundered Crown (II)
quests.desc: The pieces of the Hollow King lie in barrows, throne-halls, ships and ice from High Rock to Akavir.
quests.pitch: A grave-warden says someone has been taking pieces of royal regalia from tombs, one realm at a time.

objectives.text: Descend into Old Orsinium and find the hammer-forged piece in the lowest forge.
Examine the barrow's mural for the missing finger of the ancient king.
Climb into the howe's ship and find the crown in its keel-chest.
Reach the ice throne and face whoever has gathered the Hollow King.

quests.outro: At the ice throne I found the last piece already in the thief's hands: a woman in a pilgrim's cloak who wept as she held the crown. She had never wanted him whole. She wanted him found. I helped her bury him again, deeper.

quests.title: The Silent Falls

find.text: A pilgrim's notebook left on a flat rock: eight falls named, six crossed out with the date and a single word, 'hushed'. 'Tonight: the pool at Mist Mirror. Do not be near the water when it stops.'

quests.desc: A pilgrim's notebook names eight waterfalls, six crossed out as 'hushed', and warns that tonight is the pool at Mist Mirror.
quests.pitch: A pilgrim says the waterfalls are falling silent in order, one a night, and nobody can stop it.

objectives.text: Stand at the base of Waterdancer Falls when the water falls silent.
Wait at the waterfall court of Tor Hame Khard for the hush.
Sit beneath the aqueduct's arches on the night the channel stops.

quests.outro: One thread of the trail ends here and the next begins. The hush has moved from falls and aqueducts to a lava-cascade, a weeping inn, an ice seam and finally to the Black Marsh falls.

quests.title: The Silent Falls (II)
quests.desc: The hush has moved from falls and aqueducts to a lava-cascade, a weeping inn, an ice seam and finally to the Black Marsh falls.
quests.pitch: A pilgrim says the waterfalls are falling silent in order, one a night, and nobody can stop it.

objectives.text: Visit the lava-cascade's grotto at Molag Mar the night it falls silent.
Sit beside the weeping giant's cheek and listen as the tears slow.
Visit the stalhrim basin at the hush and note the hum's pitch.
Climb to the weeping falls and face the coven before the last verse.

quests.outro: I stood in the spray of the last falls as the water dropped to a whisper and the wamasu in the rock began to weep. The coven's eighth verse was unfinished. I sang the other eight from memory, in the old tongue. The water remembered its voice.
